name: ceo-inbox-draft-edit
description: Update an existing draft email in the CEO's personal inbox — change its recipients (to/cc), subject, or body. Use to fix a draft that was already created (e.g. wrong recipient or outdated body) without recreating it. Requires the draft_id from ceo-inbox-list {folder: 'DRAFTS'} or ceo-inbox-search {folder: 'DRAFTS'}. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the CEO's personal email via dedicated secrets, do not call from other agents.

inputs.draft_id: string (Nylas draft ID to update — obtain from ceo-inbox-list or ceo-inbox-search scoped to DRAFTS)
inputs.to: string[]? (new recipient email addresses — replaces the existing to list)
inputs.cc: string[]? (new CC email addresses — replaces the existing cc list; pass [] to clear)
inputs.subject: string? (new subject line)
inputs.body: string? (new email body; markdown supported, converted to HTML automatically)
